verdict.rationale: Letta offers an --ephemeral CLI flag for one-shot runs that don't persist agent state, memory, or MemFS, and a cloud sandbox mode for running agents without local setup, both of which support testing without persisting to normal storage. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated sandbox/staging environment distinct from a 'production' Letta org or dataset, nor guidance on isolating test runs from live customer data. Missing for 10: explicit staging/production environment separation, documented test-data isolation guarantees, and independent verification that ephemeral/cloud sandbox runs never touch production stores.
